zymases: n. 1. zymase — a complex of enzymes that cause glycolysis; originally found in yeast but also present in higher organisms
zymolysises: n. 1. fermenter, fermentation — a process in which an agent causes an organic substance to break down into simpler substances; especially, the anaerobic breakdown of sugar into alcohol
zymosises: n. 1. fermenter, fermentation — a process in which an agent causes an organic substance to break down into simpler substances; especially, the anaerobic breakdown of sugar into alcohol
zyrians: n. 1. Communauté de communes de Chautagne — the Finnic language spoken by the Komi
